name: 共参照チェーン分析
description: 調査します 共参照 解像度 chains を識別するために AI生成の text through abnormal entity tracking and pronominal reference パターン.
useCase: 一貫性のない、または過度に単純化された実体参照チェーンによるAIテキストの検出
mechanism: Constructs 共参照 chains linking mentions of the same entity throughout the text (代名詞s, noun phrases, proper names). AI生成の text often shows shorter 共参照 chains, less complex reference 解像度s, and occasional entity confusion—where referents are ambiguously or incorrectly resolved. The method 測定する chain length 分布, referential distance, and chain branching complexity.
source: Dugan, L. et al. (2024) - RAID: A Shared Benchmark for Robust Evaluation of Machine-Generated Text Detectors, ACL
algorithm: Coreference Resolution + Chain Statistics + Anomaly Scoring
parameters: モデル: neural 共参照 resolver, Min chain length: 2 mentions, Metrics: chain density, avg distance, branching factor, Text min: 200 words
strengths:
• Captures deep discourse-level 一貫性
• Effective on long-form narratives and essays
• 検出します subtle entity tracking failures
• Orthogonal to surface-level 特徴
limitations:
• 計算コストが高い for long texts
• Coreference 解像度 itself is imperfect
• Short texts yield too few chains for 分析
• Performance depends on 共参照 model quality

references.title: Dugan, L. et al. (2024). RAID: A Shared Benchmark for Robust Evaluation of Machine-Generated Text Detectors. ACL.
Clark, K. & Manning, C. D. (2016). Deep Reinforcement Learning for Mention-Ranking Coreference Models. EMNLP.
Pu, J. et al. (2023). On the Zero-Shot Generalization of Machine-Generated Text Detectors. EMNLP Findings.
